name: Gorgonopsid Pack-Leader
journal_prompt: A big sabre-toothed gorgonopsid of a line the Asura once bred to lead war-packs. The packs are long gone; this one lies sphinx-still by a basalt gate and lets the road go by.
appearance: A large gorgonopsid: a sabre-toothed Permian synapsid, long-skulled and heavy-shouldered, larger than the rest of its line.
